## Search/content evidence

Complete this section for every new search-targeted page or material content rewrite.

- [ ] Primary user intent is defined.
- [ ] Target query and target market are recorded.
- [ ] Current live SERP was reviewed on the date below.
- [ ] Leading relevant competitor/result coverage was reviewed.
- [ ] The specific Smart Web Utility value advantage is documented.
- [ ] Semantic entities, terminology, edge cases and follow-up questions were reviewed.
- [ ] The page is not padded to reach a word count or keyword-density target.

## Hard content-quality gate

- [ ] Semantically optimized for the actual task.
- [ ] Skimmable with descriptive headings and focused paragraphs.
- [ ] More useful than relevant current competitors for the intended query.
- [ ] Easy to read for the intended audience.
- [ ] Written/reviewed in native-quality language for the published locale.
- [ ] Proofread for grammar, spelling and punctuation.
- [ ] Uses active voice by default; any passive constructions are intentional and clearer.
- [ ] Important limitations and interpretation guidance are present where needed.
- [ ] Related internal links help the user without cannibalizing intent.

## SEO / AEO / GEO / AIO / SXO

- [ ] Unique title, meta description and canonical are correct.
- [ ] One clear H1.
- [ ] Structured data matches visible content and functionality.
- [ ] Search/AEO answer is visible in normal HTML.
- [ ] Navigation, tool catalog and sitemap are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Mobile UX, labels, keyboard use and error states were checked.
- [ ] No unsupported ranking, approval or AI-citation claims were added.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/seo-static-qa.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/content-quality-qa.py`
- [ ] Relevant JavaScript/PHP syntax checks
- [ ] Chromium/browser smoke tests
- [ ] AdSense readiness reviewed for publisher-content value

See `CONTENT_QUALITY_STANDARD.md` and `NEW_PAGE_SEO_RELEASE_STANDARD.md`.
